title: Firm rule profiles for the fleet layer (engine/firms.py)
how_to_read: {"v": value, "verified": bool, "src": [...], "date": "yyyy-mm-dd", "n": note}:   verified true   the repo's research marks it confirmed: the firm's own help / plan page (read through web search), or the                   owner's own screenshots / receipts (MFFU). Re-check on the firm's site before money depends on it.   verified false  a third-party summary, a conflict between sources, or one source only.   v null          unknown: the value was assumed in research or not found. Never guessed here.   v "none"        the rule does not exist on that plan (e.g. no daily loss limit), per the sources. Prices: only the owner's real prices (MFFU); every other price is null ("check current codes before buying", CLAUDE.md).

bots.n: automation allowed when it runs your own parameters and you oversee it; high-frequency trading and tools that exploit simulated fills are banned. Some third-party pages still say 'semi-automated only' (older text): be at the PC or on the phone while it trades

copy_trading.n: MFFU's help center: copy trading is allowed across all MFFU account types (Tradesyncer is its preferred copier; your own software is fine). Only YOUR OWN accounts: copying another person or a group is banned (fair play). MFFU gives no help, support or reset for a copier mistake. A same-signal copy does not help a consistency rule

hedging.n: no long and short on the same underlying at the same time, also across your accounts

flat_by.n: flat by 16:10 ET (auto-liquidation); on CME half days you flatten yourself before the early halt

bots.n: automated systems and trade copiers are permitted; you carry any software error. HFT and microscalping (over 50% of the profit from trades held 5 s or less) are banned. The older LucidDirect agreement (2025-05, another product) asks prior written approval for automated software: ask support once, in writing

copy_trading.n: in-platform and third-party copiers permitted (copier set-up errors are yours); copying the same signal at another firm is not addressed directly

hedging.n: no opposite positions across your own accounts, other users' accounts or other firms' accounts (minis and micros of one contract count together); live accounts: a permanent ban

flat_by.n: flat by 4:45 PM ET Mon-Fri (open positions are closed, no fail); half days: flat before the early close

ninjatrader.n: NinjaTrader runs on Lucid's Tradovate (CQG) data: buy the TDV/NT version, not the Rithmic one; sign into Tradovate first

inactivity_days.n: an account with no net P/L of at least $1 in 30 calendar days is deleted

bots.n: EAs / bots allowed in the Challenge and the FundedNext account; BUT the FAQ adds that each EA or bot must run a distinct strategy, avoiding identical trades across any accounts (conflicts with copying one signal): ask FundedNext in writing

copy_trading.n: the Futures copy policy allows copying your OWN trades between your FundedNext accounts or between FundedNext and other prop firms (same name, verified accounts); the EA rule 'no identical trades across any accounts' conflicts: a written yes is needed

hedging.n: cross-account hedging within FundedNext or with other firms is not allowed

flat_by.n: trading 17:00-15:10 CT; open positions closed at 15:10 CT (16:10 ET); half days: flatten yourself before the early close

inactivity_days.n: 30 calendar days with no trade: the account is breached

hold.v: FundedNext's bot rule asks for no identical trades across accounts: copy the LIT signal there only after FundedNext says yes in writing, then clear this hold
hold.n: the owner's hold (engine/firms.check blocks new entries while it is set): clear it per account with rules {"hold": "none"} once the written yes is in. 2026-11-16 re-check: FundedNext's copy policy article now says copying your OWN trades between your FundedNext accounts and other firms is allowed (same verified owner), but its terms still ban mirroring without written approval and its FAQ still flags identical trades: the hold stays until the written yes. RAPID code (FundedNext's own page, from 2026-11-05): Rapid Daily 50K $149.99 for a new user

bots.n: Apex bans automated trading on all accounts (Sep 2026, third-party)
API bots on the Combine / XFA, banned on Live Funded; no VPS

ninjatrader.n: TopstepX only for new sign-ups (NinjaTrader not offered): this bot cannot route there today
NinjaTrader / Tradovate not offered for new accounts since 2026-07-12

lucid_pro_50k.name: LucidPro 50K

price.n: list $172 (some pages $192); 30% codes seen in Nov 2026 (VAULT, ETFPROMO, PFT, DGT: affiliate pages, unconfirmed) -> about $120-$134 for the daily-loss-on version (one deal page: $115.40 on / $140.40 off). One-time fee, no activation fee. Black Friday 2026: not announced on 2026-11-07. Confirm at checkout

dd_type.n: the max loss follows the highest END-OF-DAY closing balance; open losses are read as counting during the day (the strict reading)

lock.n: once the closing balance passes the $52,100 trail balance the floor locks at $50,100

dll.n: the daily-loss-ON version (chosen at checkout, the cheaper one; it cannot be changed later). The OFF version has no daily limit; this profile keeps $1,200 (stricter)

dll_type.n: every Lucid daily loss is soft: locked out until the next session, never a fail unless the max loss is hit

consistency.n: no consistency rule in the evaluation

min_days.n: can pass in one trading day

news.n: news trading allowed on LucidPro / Flex / Direct (banned only on LucidDaily funded)

lock.n: locked floor $50,100

dll.n: fixed $1,200 until the account closes above $52,100, then the LucidScale daily loss = 60% of the highest end-of-day profit (it never goes down). Only ever looser, so the fixed $1,200 is kept (stricter)

max_micros.n: no scaling plan: the full size from day one

max_active.n: no cap per plan: Lucid's 5 funded per household covers every product (copy_profiles.json accounts.lucid)

buffer.n: buffer = the initial max loss + $100: the balance stays at or above $52,100, nothing below it can be withdrawn

max.n: the first payout up to $2,000

share.n: no share-of-profit cap on a request

split.n: 90/10 (100% of the first $10K only for accounts bought or reset before 2025-11-28 15:00 ET)

consistency.n: the biggest day <= 40% of the cycle's total profit; resets after each payout (35% for accounts bought or reset on or before 2025-11-28)

min_days.n: no fixed payout window: any day once every condition is met

max_payouts.n: payout 5 is the top payout level; Lucid's risk team decides the move to a live account (at least 1 payout needed): the sim account is modelled as ending after 5

first_wait_days.n: no waiting period after the first trade

max_after_first.n: from the second payout on up to $2,500

cycle_min.n: profit goal: at least $500 of profit in the payout cycle (it resets after each payout)

daily loss: the ON version ($1,200 soft) is the profile; OFF = no daily limit (dearer)
funded LucidScale daily loss (60% of the best end-of-day profit) not modelled (only looser)
payout caps $2,000 first / $2,500 after; 40% best day of the cycle; $500 profit a cycle; 90%
